notes.text:
**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.16.130)** (Vayetzei); continued in **[the next paragraph](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.16.131)**. R. Elazar: אָמַר רִבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, תָּא חֲזֵי, בְּכָל אֲתַר יוֹבְלָא סָתִים דְּלָא אִתְגַּלְּיָא וּשְׁמִטָּה אִתְגַּלְּיָא. תָּא חֲזֵי, בְּשַׁעְתָּא דְּיַעֲקֹב פָּלַח שֶׁבַע שְׁנִין קַדְמָאִין, נָפְקָא קָלָא וְאָמַר, יַעֲקֹב, מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם — the Jubilee is always concealed and the Shemitah revealed; when Yaakov served his first seven years a voice proclaimed "from world to world" (Tehillim 106:48), the hidden upper world of the Jubilee. The daf is confirmed: both paragraphs stand on 153b.
The print reads יובלת; the Zohar reads יוֹבְלָא (Jubilee), as Rav Tzadok himself writes in ¶2 (דְּיוֹבְלָא). *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar III 249a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Pinchas.113.768)** (Pinchas). The Vav as the six sefirot that issue from the upper Heh (Binah, "Imma"): אוף הכי ו' דכליל שית ספיראן — "so too the Vav, which includes six sefirot"; the same phrase Rav Tzadok uses at [1.15–1.16]. The pairing of Leah's six sons and daughter with the six sefirot and Malchut is the Zohar's own, see the next note. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.133-134)** (Vayetzei). רָחֵל אוֹלִידַת תְּרֵין צַדִּיקִים ... וְעַל דָּא, יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִין תְּרֵין צַדִּיקִין נִינְהוּ. יוֹסֵף זָכָה לְמֶהוֵי צַדִּיק לְעֵילָא, בְּגִין דְּנָטַר אָת קַיָּימָא. בִּנְיָמִין אִיהוּ צַדִּיק לְתַתָּא, לְאִתְעַטְּרָא שְׁמִטָּה בֵּין תְּרֵי צַדִּיקֵי — Rachel bore two tzaddikim; Yosef merited to be the tzaddik above because he guarded the covenant, Binyamin is the tzaddik below, so that the Shemitah is crowned between two tzaddikim. The paragraph just before (**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.132)**) says לאה אולידת שית בנין וברתא חדא ... שית סטרין, the source of [1.18–1.19]. *Mafteach: missing*

notes.anchor: (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א, קעו עַמּוּד ב),
notes.text: **[Zohar I 176b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayishlach.22.228)** (Vayishlach). וְעַל דָּא שְׁכִינְתָא מִתְקַטְּרָא בְּאַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף, כְּחֲדָא אִינוּן וְדִיוּקְנָא חָדָא לְהוּ. הֲדָא הוּא דִּכְתִיב אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף — Yaakov and Yosef are as one and share one image, as "these are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef" (Bereshit 37:2). Daf confirmed. *Mafteach: found*

**[Zohar III 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayikra.25.191)** (Vayikra). Yaakov is "He who makes peace in His heights" (Iyov 25:2) and is given "truth" (Michah 7:20): וּכְתִיב וְהָאֱמֶת וְהַשָּׁלוֹם אֱהָבוּ. דֶּאֱמֶת וְשָׁלוֹם קָשִׁיר דָּא בְּדָא — truth (Yaakov) and peace (Yesod, Yosef) are bound together. The words fall after the 12b page break in Sefaria's text. *Mafteach: found*

**[Isaiah 60:21](https://www.sefaria.org/Isaiah.60.21)**. וְעַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים לְעוֹלָם יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ — "Your people are all righteous, they shall inherit the land forever." The verse runs through the whole os as the thing Yosef "clarifies." *Mafteach: found*

**[Zohar II 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vaera.1.20)** (Vaera). The exact words: וְכָל מַאן דְּאִתְגְּזַר, אִקְרֵי צַדִּיק. דִּכְתִּיב, וְעַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים — "whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik, as it says, Your people are all righteous"; the passage goes on to Yosef, who was called tzaddik once he guarded the covenant. Rav Tzadok himself gives this daf for the line in Peri Tzadik, Nitzavim 11 (זח"ב כ"ג א'). *Mafteach: wrong address (index: Zohar II 26a; correct: Zohar II 23a)*

notes.anchor: (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א, צג עַמּוּד א).
notes.text: **[Zohar I 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Lech_Lecha.35.444)** (Lech Lecha). Whoever is circumcised is beyond the reach of the unholy and does not descend to Gehinnom, דִּכְתִיב וְעַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים ... (כל אנון (צג א) דאתגזרו אקרון צדיקים — "all who are circumcised are called tzaddikim." The 93a page mark falls inside this sentence. The objection Rav Tzadok answers ("there are claims against Israel") is raised in **[Zohar I 91b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Lech_Lecha.33.379-380)**: וכי כלהו ישראל צדיקי נינהו והא כמה חייבין אית בהו — answered there too through the covenant of milah. *Mafteach: wrong address (index: Zohar I 91b (quote כד אתגזר ... אקרי אברהם); correct: Zohar I 93a)*

**[Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.3.6.2)**. מִכֹּל אַבְקַת רוֹכֵל זֶה יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ שֶׁהָיְתָה מִטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנָיו וְלֹא נִמְצָא בָהֶן פְּסֹלֶת — "all the powders of the merchant" is Yaakov, whose bed (offspring) was complete, with no unworthy one among them. The Zohar at I 176b (above, [1.29]) reads the same verse of Yaakov and Yosef. Not named by Rav Tzadok. *Mafteach: missing*
**[Amos 5:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Amos.5.15)**. אוּלַי יֶחֱנַן ה' צְבָאוֹת שְׁאֵרִית יוֹסֵף — "perhaps Hashem, God of hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Yosef." *Mafteach: found*

**[Bereshit Rabbah 71:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.71.2)**. לְפִי שֶׁכָּל הַדְּבָרִים תְּלוּיִין בְּרָחֵל, לְפִיכָךְ נִקְרְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל שְׁמָהּ ... וְלֹא סוֹף דָּבָר לִשְׁמָהּ, אֶלָּא לְשֵׁם בְּנָהּ, אוּלַי יֶחֱנַן ה' צְבָאוֹת שְׁאֵרִית יוֹסֵף — because everything depended on Rachel, Israel are called by her name, and not only hers but her son's: "the remnant of Yosef." *Mafteach: found*

**[Bereshit Rabbah 73:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.73.7)**. כֵּיוָן שֶׁנּוֹלַד יוֹסֵף נוֹלַד שִׂטְנוֹ שֶׁל עֵשָׂו ... מָסוֹרֶת הִיא שֶׁאֵין עֵשָׂו נוֹפֵל אֶלָּא בְּיַד בָּנֶיהָ שֶׁל רָחֵל — once Yosef was born, Esav's adversary was born; by tradition Esav falls only by the hand of Rachel's sons. The same tradition recurs at **[Bereshit Rabbah 75:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.75.5)** and **[Bereshit Rabbah 99:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.99.2)**. *Mafteach: found*

**Parallels:** [Peri Tzadik, Nitzavim 11](#/read/Peri_Tzadik,_Nitzavim_11) (Rav Tzadok) — the same chain: Esav falls only by Rachel's sons (Bereshit Rabbah 73), Mashiach ben Yosef wins the war against the nations and Mashiach ben David the war of Gog; and the same proof that "whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik" (Zohar II 23a), so that "Your people are all righteous" removes the nations' claim. It adds Shabbat as יומא דנשמתין for the messianic age. *checked*

**[Psalms 80:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Psalms.80.3)**. לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ — "before Ephraim, Binyamin and Menashe, stir up Your might and come to save us": the three tribes of Rachel are named for the victory. *Mafteach: missing*

**Parallels:** [Peri Tzadik, Rosh Chodesh Adar 10](#/read/Peri_Tzadik,_Rosh_Chodesh_Adar_10) (Rav Tzadok) — the same verse (Tehillim 80:3) and the same tradition from Bereshit Rabbah 73: Menashe, Ephraim and Binyamin are "for the conquest of the nations"; Yehoshua of Ephraim was first against Amalek and Shaul of Binyamin was also commanded. It adds the months: First Adar for Menashe, Second Adar (Purim) for Ephraim. *checked*

**[I Samuel 15:3](https://www.sefaria.org/I_Samuel.15.3)**; **[I Samuel 15:9](https://www.sefaria.org/I_Samuel.15.9)**. Shaul was told וְהַחֲרַמְתֶּם אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ, yet וַיַּחְמֹל שָׁאוּל וְהָעָם עַל אֲגָג — he spared Agag, so the eradication was not completed. The print reads ננמר; read נִגְמַר ("completed"), a נ/ג confusion; the translation follows the correction. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 154a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.140)** (Vayetzei). וְעַל דָּא, אִינוּן שֶׁבַע שְׁנִין קַדְמָאֵי אִתְכַּסְּיָין, דְּלָא יָדַע בְּהוּ יַעֲקֹב בְּגִין דְּהֲווּ דְּיוֹבְלָא, וְאִינוּן דִּשְׁמִטָּה אִתְגַּלְיָין — the first seven years were concealed, Yaakov not knowing of them, because they belonged to the Jubilee; those of the Shemitah were revealed. Daf confirmed. Sefaria reads קַדְמָאֵי where the print has קדמאין (the form the Zohar uses on 153b). *Mafteach: missing*

**Parallels beyond the library:** **[Mikdash Melekh on Zohar 1:153b:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Mikdash_Melekh_on_Zohar_1:153b:6)** (Kabbalah) — R. Shalom Buzaglo, quoting the Arizal, explains why the first seven years were hidden from Yaakov: they were Leah's, from the upper half of Ze'ir Anpin that Yaakov did not yet grasp before he was named Yisrael; he thought he was serving for Rachel.
אסתימו מיעקב הז' של לאה ... שבדעתו ברחל הוא עובד והאמת היה בלאה

**[Berakhot 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.17a)**. R. Alexandri's prayer: רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים, גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לְפָנֶיךָ שֶׁרְצוֹנֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ, וּמִי מְעַכֵּב? שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה — our will is to do Your will; what holds us back is the leaven in the dough. Rav Tzadok places this inner will in the hidden seven years, and the deed in the revealed seven. Not named. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Genesis 42:18](https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.42.18)**. אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲנִי יָרֵא — Yosef to his brothers. **[Bereshit Rabbah 99:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.99.2)** sets this verse against Amalek's וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִים (Devarim 25:18) and ends שֶׁאֵין עֵשָׂו נוֹפֵל אֶלָּא בְּיַד בָּנֶיהָ שֶׁל רָחֵל, the thread of this os. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.135)** (Vayetzei). וְכִי בִּנְיָמִין צַדִּיק הֲוָה, אִין. דְּכָל יוֹמוֹי לָא חָטָא בְּהַאי אָת קַיָּימָא — was Binyamin a tzaddik? Yes: all his days he did not sin with this sign of the covenant (he did not live with his wife all the years Yaakov mourned Yosef). *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 154a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.141)** (Vayetzei). Where are the "seven times seven" of the Jubilee (Vayikra 25:8)? אֶלָּא, אִינוּן שִׁבְעָה יוֹמִין דְּנָטַר בְּהִלּוּלָא דְלֵאָה אַשְׁלִימוּ חוּשְׁבְּנָא ... וְכָל שִׁבְעָה אִשְׁתְּלִים בְּשִׁבְעָה יוֹמִין — the seven days he waited in Leah's wedding feast completed the count, each day being one "time" of seven. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 154a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.138)** (Vayetzei). אוֹרִיךְ בְּלָבָן כָּל כָּךְ עַד דְּיִסְתַּיֵּים גּוּפָא, וּמַאן הוּא סִיּוּמָא דְגוּפָא, בְּרִית. וְעַל דָּא כְּתִיב וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה רָחֵל אֶת יוֹסֵף — Yaakov stayed with Lavan until "the body was completed," the covenant being its culmination; therefore once Yosef was born (Bereshit 30:25) he asked to leave. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 154a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.17.140)** (Vayetzei). דִּכְתִיב וַיַּעֲבֹד יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים. שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים סְתָם. בְּרָחֵל פָּלַח שֶׁבַע שְׁנִין עִלָּאִין, וְאִתְאֲחִיד בְּהוּ בִּתְרֵי עָלְמִין. מִכָּאן אוֹלִיפְנָא, מִגּוֹ דְּאִתְגַּלְּיָא, אָתֵי בַּר נָשׁ לִסְתִימָאָה — "seven years" unqualified (Bereshit 29:20): for Rachel he served the supernal years and was joined through them to both worlds; through the revealed one comes to the hidden.
The Zohar does read בְּרָחֵל here, so the printed ברחל is correct and not a slip for בלאה. The Zohar's verb is וְאִתְאֲחִיד; the print has the defective ואתאחד. *Mafteach: missing*

**Parallels beyond the library:** **[Ketem Paz on Zohar 153a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketem_Paz_on_Zohar.153a.6)** (Kabbalah) — R. Shimon Lavi on this Zohar: Rachel's revealed seven years are the gateway to Leah's hidden seven, though these came first; the revealed is the ladder to the hidden, close to Rav Tzadok's order of hidden root and revealed deed.
כי הנגלה סולם ומבוא אל הנסתר כן היו ז' שנים של רחל שער ומבוא אל הז' של לאה

**[Bereshit Rabbah 84:19](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.84.19)**. On "Reuven returned to the pit" (Bereshit 37:29): אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, מֵעוֹלָם לֹא חָטָא אָדָם לְפָנַי וְעָשָׂה תְּשׁוּבָה, וְאַתָּה פָּתַחְתָּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה תְּחִלָּה — no one had sinned and repented before Me; you opened the way of teshuvah first. *Mafteach: found*

**[Zohar III 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Metzora.7.23)** (Metzora). מֹשֶׁה עִלָּאָה, מֹשֶׁה שׁוּשְׁבִינָא דְּמַלְכָּא, אַהֲרֹן שׁוּשְׁבִינָא דְּמַטְרוֹנִיתָא — Moshe is higher: the King's groomsman; Aharon the Matronita's, appointed to adorn her and tend the house. Daf confirmed. The index lists the line under Zohar III 20a, 3b and 275b; 20a and 275b do carry the phrase, 3b does not, and 53b, the daf Rav Tzadok gives, is not listed. *Mafteach: wrong address (index: Zohar III 20a; correct: Zohar III 53b)*
**[I Chronicles 12:33](https://www.sefaria.org/I_Chronicles.12.33)**. וּמִבְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר יוֹדְעֵי בִינָה לָעִתִּים לָדַעַת מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל. *Mafteach: found*

**[Yoma 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.26a)**. אָמַר רָבָא: לָא מַשְׁכַּחַתְּ צוּרְבָא מֵרַבָּנַן דְּמוֹרֵי אֶלָּא דְּאָתֵי מִשֵּׁבֶט לֵוִי אוֹ מִשֵּׁבֶט יִשָּׂשכָר — Levi from "they shall teach Your laws to Yaakov" (Devarim 33:10), Yissachar from "who know understanding of the times" (I Divrei HaYamim 12:33). *Mafteach: found*

**[Pirkei Avot 4:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_Avot.4.1)**. אֵיזֶהוּ גִבּוֹר? הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר טוֹב אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם מִגִּבּוֹר — Ben Zoma: the mighty one conquers his inclination. Rav Tzadok ties גְּבוּרָה here to "stir up Your might" (Tehillim 80:3) said of Rachel's tribes. *Mafteach: found*

**[Zohar I 152b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.14.96-97)** (Vayetzei). תָּא חֲזֵי הַאי בְּאֵר, שֶׁבַע זִמְנִין כְּתִיב בְּפָרְשָׁתָא דָא, בְּגִין דְּאִיהוּ רֶמֶז לְשֶׁבַע ... בְּמשֶׁה לָא כְּתִיב אֶלָּא זִמְנָא חָדָא ... בְּגִין דְּמשֶׁה, אִתְפָּרַשׁ מִכֹּל וָכֹל מִבֵּיתָא דִלְתַתָּא, וְיַעֲקֹב לָא אִתְפָּרַשׁ כְּלָל — "well" appears seven times in Yaakov's story (Bereshit 29:2–10) but once with Moshe (Shemot 2:15), because Moshe separated entirely from the house below and Yaakov did not. The passage stands near the top of 152b. *Mafteach: found*

**[Tikkunei Zohar 29a:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Tikkunei_Zohar.29a.7)** (Tikkun 13). ויעקב ודאי איהו דיוקנא דעמודא דאמצעיתא מסטרא דלבר. והא משה תמן הוה אלא מסטרא דלגאו הוה. דא מגופא ודא מנשמתא — Yaakov is the image of the Central Pillar from outside, Moshe from inside: one of the body, one of the soul. The next tikkun (תקונא ארביסר) opens on 30a, so 29a is Tikkun 13. *Mafteach: found*

**Parallels:** [Peri Tzadik, Vayeshev 13](#/read/Peri_Tzadik,_Vayeshev_13) (Rav Tzadok) — Yaakov and Moshe are one, from the same Tikkun 13; Moshe's birth filled the house with light (Sotah 12a); Yaakov had no struggle of his own with the evil inclination, being like Adam before the sin, and his whole concern was that his bed be complete. It adds that "the rage of Yosef" was still needed to clarify his offspring in the attribute of Tzaddik. *checked*

**[Sotah 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.12a)**. On "she saw that he was good" (Shemot 2:2): וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁנּוֹלַד מֹשֶׁה נִתְמַלֵּא הַבַּיִת כּוּלּוֹ אוֹר — the Sages say that when Moshe was born the whole house was filled with light, learned from "God saw the light, that it was good." *Mafteach: missing*

**[Bereshit Rabbah 47:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.47.6)**. הָאָבוֹת הֵן הֵן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה — "the Patriarchs are themselves the chariot." Not named; Rav Tzadok pairs Yaakov with the Name Havayah (compare Peri Tzadik, Vayeshev 13). *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.16.128)** (Vayetzei). כֻּלְּהוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנִין עִלָּאִין, שָׁרוּ עֲלֵיהּ דְּיַעֲקֹב עַד לָא נָסִיב לָהּ לְרָחֵל ... דְּהָא יַעֲקֹב נָטַל כֻּלְּהוּ בְּקַדְמִיתָא, וּלְבָתַר אֲתָא לְגַבָּהּ, בְּגִין לְאִשְׁתַּכָּחָא אִיהוּ שָׁמַיִם, וְאִיהִי אָרֶץ — all seven supernal years rested on Yaakov before he took Rachel, so that he would be heaven and she earth. Daf confirmed. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Sanhedrin 91b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.91b)**, on **[Psalms 50:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Psalms.50.4)**. Antoninus and Rebbi, the parable of the lame and the blind: יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל — זוֹ נְשָׁמָה, וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ — זֶה הַגּוּף. Heaven is the soul and earth the body, which lets Rav Tzadok read the Zohar's "Yaakov heaven, Rachel earth." *Mafteach: found*

**[Bereshit Rabbah 68:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.68.10)**. On "he lodged there because the sun had set" (Bereshit 28:11): the angels said בָּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ, בָּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ, אֲתָא שִׁמְשָׁא, אֲתָא שִׁמְשָׁא — "the sun has come"; and when Yosef dreamed of the sun, Yaakov said "who revealed to him that my name is Sun?" *Mafteach: found*

**[Bava Batra 75a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.75a)**. On "put some of your majesty upon him" (Bamidbar 27:20): זְקֵנִים שֶׁבְּאוֹתוֹ הַדּוֹר אָמְרוּ, פְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה כִּפְנֵי חַמָּה, פְּנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּפְנֵי לְבָנָה — Moshe's face was like the sun, Yehoshua's like the moon. *Mafteach: found*

**[Jeremiah 11:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Jeremiah.11.15)**. וּבְשַׂר קֹדֶשׁ יַעַבְרוּ מֵעָלָיִךְ — "holy flesh" (the sacrificial meat) said of Israel; Rav Tzadok reads it of the bodies of Israel clarified in holiness. Not named. *Mafteach: missing*

notes.anchor: (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב, רה סוֹף עַמּוּד א),
notes.text: **[Zohar II 205a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayakhel.15.206)** (Vayakhel). הַאי יוֹמָא, יוֹמָא דְּנִשְׁמָתִין אִיהוּ, וְלָאו יוֹמָא דְּגוּפָא, בְּגִין דְּשֻׁלְטָנוּ דִּצְרוֹרָא דְּנִשְׁמָתִין אִיהוּ — Shabbat is a day of souls, not of the body, being the rule of the bundle of souls. The 205b page break falls later in the same paragraph, so the words stand at the end of 205a, as he says. *Mafteach: found*

**Parallels beyond the library:** **[Sefat Emet, Exodus, Ki Tisa 12](https://www.sefaria.org/Sefat_Emet,_Exodus,_Ki_Tisa.12)** (Chassidus) — the same Zohar line ("Shabbat is a day of souls, not of the body") read the way Rav Tzadok reads it: on Shabbat heaven and earth become one, and the earth (the body) receives a soul and is raised from body to soul, which is "He rested and was refreshed (וַיִּנָּפַשׁ)."
ובשבת נעשה הכל אחד שמים וארץ

**[Deuteronomy 33:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Deuteronomy.33.1)** with **[Zohar I 236b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayechi.57.559)** (Vayechi). וְזֹאת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַךְ מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים; the Zohar: משה איש האלהים מאריה דביתא מאריה דמטרוניתא כמה דכתיב אישה יקימנו ואישה יפרנו — "man of God" means master of the house, husband of the Matronita. The index's Zohar II 22b (**[Zohar II 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vaera.1.12)**: משה אלמלא דהוה מאריה דביתא איש האלהים) makes the same equation. *Mafteach: found*

**[Exodus 2:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Exodus.2.15)** with **[Zohar I 152b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.14.97)**. וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְיָן וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר; the Zohar: וּבְגִין כָּךְ משֶׁה מָארֵיהּ דְּבֵיתָא הֲוָה, וְאִסְתַּלַּק לְעֵילָא, בְּמשֶׁה כְּתִיב וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר — Moshe "sat above" the well as its master; Yaakov only "saw a well in the field." *Mafteach: missing*
**[Genesis 29:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.29.2)**. וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה, the first of the seven mentions the Zohar counts in Bereshit 29:2–10. *Mafteach: found*

**[Zohar I 153b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Vayetzei.16.130)** (Vayetzei) on **[Genesis 29:19](https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.29.19)**. תָּא חֲזֵי, דְּאָפִילּוּ לָבָן רָמַז לֵיהּ בְּאִינוּן שֶׁבַע, וְלָא יָדַע מַאי קָאֲמַר, דְּפָתַח וְאָמַר טוֹב, דִּכְתִיב טוֹב תִּתִּי וְגו' — even Lavan hinted at the seven without knowing what he said, opening with "good": טוֹב תִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לָךְ מִתִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר. Daf confirmed; it is the paragraph just before the one quoted at [1.2]. *Mafteach: missing*

**[Zohar I 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Noach.3.19)** (Noach). דָּבָר אַחֵר טוֹב אִישׁ, דָּא צַדִּיק דִּכְתִיב אִמְרוּ צַדִּיק כִּי טוֹב — "good" is the tzaddik, as it says "say of the tzaddik that he is good." Rav Tzadok drops the word אִישׁ. Daf confirmed. *Mafteach: found*

**[Isaiah 3:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Isaiah.3.10)**. אִמְרוּ צַדִּיק כִּי טוֹב כִּי פְרִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶם יֹאכֵלוּ — "say of the tzaddik that he is good, for they shall eat the fruit of their deeds." The index files the quotation under Isaiah 2:19. *Mafteach: wrong address (index: Isaiah 2:19; correct: Isaiah 3:10)*

**[Proverbs 10:25](https://www.sefaria.org/Proverbs.10.25)**. וְצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם — "the tzaddik is the foundation of the world," the source of the sefirah's name Yesod. **[Zohar I 91b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar,_Lech_Lecha.33.380)** uses the same verse for the circumcised: כיון דעאלו בהאי חולקא דצדיק אקרון צדיקים. *Mafteach: missing*

**Parallels beyond the library:** **[Maaseh Rokeach on Mishnah, Seder Zeraim, Sheviit](https://www.sefaria.org/Maaseh_Rokeach_on_Mishnah,_Seder_Zeraim,_Sheviit)** (Kabbalah) — reads the same Zohar (Vayetzei) as Rav Tzadok does: Leah is Binah, the Jubilee, Imma Ila'ah; Rachel is Malchut, the Shemitah; and Leah's six sons answer to the six sefirot from Chesed to Yesod that issue from Binah.
רחל מלכות בסוד שמיטה, לאה בסוד בינה, יובל, אימא עילאה, כמבואר בזוהר פרשת ויצא

interlinear_fixes.why: Zohar I 154a (Vayetzei 17:140) reads וְאִתְאֲחִיד (Itpe'el, 'was joined'). The print's defective ואתאחד can carry the Zohar's vowels (chirik without yod) without changing the printed letters.
Zohar I 154a (Vayetzei 17:140) is vocalized דְּהֲווּ. The holam form is a Targum spelling; in Zohar quotations elsewhere this edition uses הֲווּ. Minor.
The phrase ו' דכליל שית ספיראן is verbatim Zohar III 249a (Sefaria Zohar, Pinchas 113:768), vocalized שִׁית סְפִירָאָן; the aleph carries a qamatz (plural -aan), not a silent aleph.
